term: necessity of one individual versus necessary exemplification
resolution: The new quantifier diagnostics use the shared Kripke Box and Dia on an explicit existence or concrete-presence extension. DeDicto allows changing witnesses; DeRe fixes a literal roster member. Neither is Scott necessary existence, a property defined through essences. The Third Way uses cannot-not-be with primitive Possible over time predicates. collective_iff substitutes Kripke Dia for that primitive only to compare the exact collective-possibility formula; it does not identify temporal plenitude with metaphysical accessibility, derive Box from negated Dia intuitionistically, or transfer any source attribution. Concreteness and existence remain distinct as DEF-NECESSARY-INDIVIDUAL-CONCRETE specifies.
